author: Ogrey
body:
<3 Special thanks to alexanderjoe10 for providing me his server <3

Hey guys, I've built a new map for Nebula, Destroy the Monument subtype called Alpha Complex.
The map itself involves a lot of spherical structures that contain iron farms, enchantment rooms, monument rooms and the spawn room. The corridors in this map have some sort of "arc" that provides 
light and some treasure chests near the iron farm and the curve corridor.

Map Name: Alpha Complex
Map Creator: Evocal
Server Owner: alexanderjoe10
Basic Info:
- Destroy the Monument (2 Monuments)
- Blue vs Red (25 vs 25)
- Iron and a few Diamond Blocks
- Enchantment Tables
- Gold Blocks provide XP Bottles
- Pre-built defense for Monuments (Quality: Low)
- Treasure Chests

Map Images:
